title: Density histograms with a legend inside: deprecated ggplot2 spellings fail under the pinned version
source_relation: original construction on the ggplot2 3.4.0/3.5.0 deprecations (..density.., size for lines, numeric legend.position) that remain common in training material
difficulty_hypothesis: Older idioms (..density.., stat(density), geom_density(size=), theme(legend.position = c(x, y))) still render; the first two emit deprecation warnings in the pinned ggplot2, while the replacements (after_stat, linewidth, legend.position = 'inside' with legend.position.inside) are version-gated. The default stacked position and count scale are secondary traps.

mcp_relevance.rationale: Three separate API changes are version-gated and the correct modern spelling requires knowing the installed ggplot2's interface (legend.position.inside, after_stat, linewidth). Documentation retrieval is directly useful; the deprecated forms still run, so the failure is only visible through warnings, which an agent that executes code may or may not read.
mcp_relevance.information_need: The current ggplot2 spelling for density-scale statistics, line widths and inside legends.
mcp_relevance.obtainable_without_mcp: partly: running the code prints the deprecation warnings that name the replacements; ?theme and ?after_stat are installed locally
alternative_solution_paths: different styling of bars and curves

calibration_risks.ceiling: moderate: strong models know after_stat and linewidth

pinned_evidence.observed: ..density.. warns 'deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0'; size for lines warns 'deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0'; a numeric legend.position is only soft-deprecated since 3.5.0 and is converted to an inside legend (the scorer cannot and does not distinguish it); legend.position = 'inside' works with legend.position.inside
pinned_evidence.oracle: built layer data: density integrates to 1 per group, counts equal group sizes, bin count equals bins; warnings under strict lifecycle options are failures
